title: Design System: Oraiza
scope: Tokens and components prefixed hp- cover only the signed-out front page '/' (HomePage.tsx/.css, under .hp). app- tokens cover the tenant app, /admin and auth/legal pages, documented in DESIGN.md's app sections.

app-body.purpose: Tenant app, admin and auth pages; also the sample screens on the front page.

hp-display.purpose: Front page hero h1: Archivo 900 stretched 118%, uppercase, one block line per sentence.

hp-headline.purpose: Front page section titles, station signs, closing board: Archivo 900 at 112% width, uppercase.

hp-body.purpose: Front page ledes and station copy in Archivo at 100% width, max 34-40em.

hp-plate-number.purpose: Gold hook-on price plates: Archivo 800 condensed to 72%, tabular lining figures.

hp-control.purpose: Front page plate and text-link labels.

shadows.name: hp-board-hang
shadows.purpose: Front page boards hanging on the wall.

shadows.name: hp-numplate-hang
shadows.purpose: Gold number plates on their hooks.

motion.name: hp-swing
motion.purpose: One number plate lifts on its hooks (rotateX to -82deg) and falls back with the next figure. Off for prefers-reduced-motion, hidden tab, and board off screen.

motion.name: hp-arrow-nudge
motion.purpose: Arrow in the red plate moves 3px on hover.

breakpoints.name: hp-phone
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: header plate hidden, red plate full width.

breakpoints.name: hp-two-panel
breakpoints.purpose: Hero board splits into two panels with a painted bar; station sign and copy go side by side.

components.name: Red Plate (front page primary)
components.description: The one primary action per screen on the front page.
components.html: Open your mill's account
components.css: .ds-hp-plate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 3px solid #16150f; border-radius: 3px; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-hp-plate:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-hp-plate:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #16150f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-hp-plate svg { transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-hp-plate:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-hp-plate-red { background: #c1271b; border-color: #c1271b; color: #fff; min-height: 60px; padding: 0 26px; font-size: 19px; box-shadow: 0 10px 18px -12px rgba(110, 18, 10, 0.75); } .ds-hp-plate-red:hover { background: #9e1f15; border-color: #9e1f15; }

components.name: Ink Plate (front page secondary)
components.description: Secondary action, e.g. the header's account plate.
components.css: .ds-hp-plate-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 3px solid #16150f; border-radius: 3px; background: #fbfbf7; color: #16150f; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-hp-plate-ink:hover { background: #16150f; color: #fbfbf7; } .ds-hp-plate-ink:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-hp-plate-ink:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #16150f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link (front page tertiary)
components.description: Log in and other tertiary links on the board.
components.css: .ds-hp-textlink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; color: #16150f; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-hp-textlink:hover { text-decoration-color: #c1271b; } .ds-hp-textlink:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #16150f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Gold Number Plate
components.description: Hook-on price plate hung from two SVG wire hooks.
components.html: ₱1,150
components.css: .ds-hp-numplate { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: flex-end; min-width: 4.5em; margin-top: 16px; padding: 8px 12px 6px; background: #edbe2f; border: 2px solid #16150f; border-radius: 3px; color: #16150f; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 72%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; font-size: 2.3rem; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 8px 10px -8px rgba(22, 21, 15, 0.6); } .ds-hp-hook { position: absolute; top: -15px; width: 12px; height: 16px; } .ds-hp-hook-l { left: 16%; } .ds-hp-hook-r { right: 16%; } .ds-hp-peso { font-size: 0.62em; margin-right: 0.12em; }

components.name: Enamel Board
components.description: White enamel board with a painted double frame and corner bolts.
components.html: Palay in. Bigas out.
components.css: .ds-hp-board { position: relative; padding: 54px 58px 50px; background: #fbfbf7; color: #16150f; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 26px 40px -30px rgba(22, 21, 15, 0.55); } .ds-hp-frame { position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 6px solid #16150f; border-radius: 4px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-hp-frame::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8px; border: 2px solid #16150f; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-hp-bolt { position: absolute; width: 14px; height: 14px; z-index: 1; } .ds-hp-caps { margin: 0; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 118%; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 0.98; font-size: 3rem; }

components.name: Station Sign
components.description: Small framed board on an SVG bracket; the heading of each route station.
components.html: Weigh-in
components.css: .ds-hp-sign { position: relative; display: inline-block; margin: 0 0 0 44px; padding: 18px 34px 16px; background: #fbfbf7; color: #16150f; border-radius: 3px; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 112%; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 0.95; font-size: 2.15rem; box-shadow: 0 14px 22px -18px rgba(22, 21, 15, 0.6); } .ds-hp-sign-frame { position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 4px solid #16150f; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-hp-sign-frame::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5px; border: 1.5px solid #16150f; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-hp-bracket { position: absolute; top: calc(50% - 6px); left: -44px; width: 44px; height: 26px; }

components.name: Sample Screen
components.description: Framed Oraiza record on the front page, in Inter, always tagged Sample data.
components.css: .ds-hp-screen { margin: 0; max-width: 600px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #c9ced6; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 18px 34px -24px rgba(22, 21, 15, 0.45); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #0f172a; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow: hidden; } .ds-hp-screen-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e6ec; background: #f8fafc; } .ds-hp-sample { padding: 2px 8px; border: 1.5px dashed #64748b; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; } .ds-hp-screen-body { padding: 20px 22px; }

narrative.overview: Front page only. The page is the enamel signboard out front of a rice mill; Oraiza is the books behind it. Flat painted enamel on a concrete wall: white boards, sign-black capitals, one red plate for the action, gold hook-on number plates. Hardware (bolts, hooks, brackets) is authored inline SVG in the same black stroke and steel fill. The real app appears only as framed sample screens, in Inter, each labeled Sample data. The rest of the product keeps the app system: Inter, emerald to cyan to violet brand gradient, glass surfaces over a mesh body.
keyCharacteristics: The page is the enamel signboard out front of a rice mill; Oraiza is the books behind it.
Flat painted enamel on a concrete wall: white boards, sign-black capitals, one red plate for the action, gold hook-on number plates.
Hardware (bolts, hooks, brackets) is authored inline SVG in the same black stroke and steel fill (`hp-bolt-steel`). No icon set, no illustrations.
The real app appears only as framed sample screens, in Inter, each labeled "Sample data".

rules.name: The One Red Plate Rule
rules.body: Red fill appears once per screen, on the one primary action. The header's account plate is ink-outline, so the hero's red plate stands alone.

rules.name: The Bare Enamel Rule
rules.body: No gradients, glass, blur or mesh on this page. Color is flat paint.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: Archivo is the sign painter's hand; Inter is the app's. Inter appears only inside sample screens, Archivo never inside them.

dos: Do keep every figure on the page sample-labeled: "Sample prices" on the board, "Sample data" on every screen.
Do draw hardware as inline SVG in `hp-ink` stroke and `hp-bolt-steel` fill.
Do use the enamel tokens through `--hp-*` variables; add new front-page rules under `.hp`.
donts: Don't put a second red fill on a screen, or make the header plate red.
Don't bring the app's gradient, glass, mesh or icon chips onto this page, and don't use icon-card grids or a browser-framed dashboard hero.
Don't use Archivo inside sample screens, or Inter on the board.
